 Ready Umbrella, Part of Jakarta Potentially Light Rain in the Afternoon 
 07 November 2026, 06:40 | Editorial Team 
 Tim VOI 
 Reporter 
 Edy Suherli 
 Editor 
 Illustration - A number of residents walk while using an umbrella when it rains lightly on the sidewalk in front of HI roundabout in Jakarta. (ANTARA/Khaerul Izan) 
 Share:
 JAKARTA - The Meteorology, Climatology and Geophysics Agency (BMKG) predicts that some areas of Jakarta on Saturday will experience light rain in the afternoon.
 BMKG through the Instagram account @infobmkg predicts that on Saturday morning at 07.00 WIB, most of the Jakarta area is expected to be thick clouds, except for Central Jakarta and East Jakarta which are predicted to be cloudy. Then, towards noon or around 10.00 WIB, almost all of Jakarta is predicted to be thick clouds.
 Meanwhile, the air temperature in the morning ranges from 26-31 degrees Celsius with an average wind speed of 1-15 kilometers (km) per hour.
 Furthermore, for the afternoon at 13.00 WIB, all areas of Jakarta are expected to be thick clouds. Meanwhile, the air temperature ranges from 29-31 degrees Celsius with wind speeds of 10-13 km per hour.
 Then in the afternoon around 16.00 WIB, some areas of Jakarta have the potential for light rain, except for North Jakarta and the Thousand Islands which will be cloudy. Meanwhile, for the afternoon air temperature ranges from 28-29 degrees Celsius with wind speeds of 3-13 km per hour.
 The next night at around 19.00 WIB, almost all of Jakarta is expected to be cloudy, except for the Thousand Islands which is cloudy. Then for the air temperature ranges from 27 - 29 degrees Celsius with wind speeds of 2-10 km per hour.
